newsitem.title: USA: Registry sees $11-13 mln charge from deal.
newsitem.headline: Registry sees $11-13 mln charge from deal.

text.p: Registry Inc said it expects to take a one-time pre-tax charge of $11 to $13 million to reflect its planned $430 million acquisition of Renaissance Solutions Inc.
The charge is expected to be incurred in the September quarter.

In a conference call to discuss the proposed transaction, Registry chief financial officer Robert Foley said the deal is expected to add $0.05 per share to earnings in 1997 and $0.10 to $0.15 per share in 1998.
Shares of Registry were down 6-1/8 to 50-3/8 in early trading. Renaissance stock rose 4-1/4 to 39.
The proposed transaction does not include a collar or other price protection mechanism, company officials said.
Registry attributed the decline to investors who may be waiting to see the outcome of the transaction, as well as momentum market players.
The companies did not comment on whether there were any other prospective bidders for Renaissance.
Registry chief executive officer Drew Conway said the company will continue to pursue specific geographic acquisitions following the deal.
